artifacts: Raw logs, traces, checkpoints, streams and observation tensors stay ignored under runs/api. After execution publish compact metrics/provenance and actual-training GIFs only. Keep technique-inventory.md as the sole generated goal leaderboard.

gates.retention: Not authorized by this protocol; separate passing smoke checkpoint dependency and predeclared tier2 budget required.
gates.smoke: Any scheduled full passing state plus one independent same-state confirmation satisfying every unchanged bound; both arms still finish1600updates.
gates.sustained_diagnostic: Also report unchanged five-terminal-full-pass reducer and longest passing streak; neither replaces smoke or confers ordinary qualification.

held_fixed: one protocol seed0; no seed sweep
uniform16-component 2D Gaussian target, ring radius3, sigma0.1
learned uniform256-row MoG prior, sigma0.1, standardizeFalse
BCAP penalty and normalized biases/sampled prior rows
constant G/D/prior rates and optimizer momentum0

restored.role: original restart reproduction; distinct runtime path, not a fresh continuous candidate control

initializer: public deterministic orthogonal named initializer; public R2 table for prior

predictions.boundary_only: A successful one-update intervention supports trajectory selection at401 in this fixed experiment; it does not establish continuous stability.
predictions.every_step: A smoke improvement supports investigating a reusable constant-rate spectral rule; full retention and task-ladder qualification remain required.
predictions.weak_direction_mechanism: Truncation sharply reduces the saved401 full-polar amplification; failure of the10x algebra criterion weakens this mechanism before any quality inference.

rng_contract.confirmation: one separate named evaluation confirmation stream, drawn only at first scheduled full passing state;4096 samples before any further update
rng_contract.data_and_prior: existing separate named training streams; checkpoint every consumed stream
rng_contract.matching: initial model hashes and seen-batch digests must agree across candidates; boundary prefix must match archived public400-state under original identity
rng_contract.training_noise: mechanism accepts isolated generator but consumes no draws

saved_matrix_probe.backend: cuda float32; no CPU SVD or dtype conversion
saved_matrix_probe.criterion: Finite factors, exact repeats on identical inputs, bit-exact full-polar parity with captured factors, unchanged ambient CPU/CUDA RNG states, and at least10x reduction in pair relative Frobenius difference vs ordinary full polar.

historical_baseline.identity: PR331 original saved-gradient probe, CUDA SVD; original pair-norm summary used saved CPU tensors

saved_matrix_probe.new_pair_norm_backend: CUDA float32; report measured values, do not demand last-bit equality to historical CPU norm summary

schedule_contract.boundary_only: Fresh public initialization and live updates1..400 unchanged; truncate all G/D matrix directions during update401, then ordinary full polar from402..1600. No restore.
schedule_contract.every_step: Fresh public initialization; truncate every G/D matrix direction during updates1..1600. No restore.
schedule_contract.rationale: A one-update change immediately after the same400-update live prefix tests path selection at the known restart boundary; continuous truncation tests removal of repeated weak-direction amplification.

stopping_rules: Freeze source/protocol before paid work; every attempt counts, no retries or repeat of consumed arms.
Reject CPU backend and non-float32 mechanism inputs before SVD; no CPU substitution for unavailable CUDA.
Finish both independent arms to1600 even if a smoke state passes.
Stop an arm on nonfinite training, source/stream mismatch, timeout or budget exhaustion; retain raw error and actual cost.
No seed changes, periodic restart, annealing, prior refresh, subbatch repeat, architecture change, threshold grid or relaxed covariance bound.
Do not spend automatically on retention or import these diagnostic results into ordinary qualification.
user_authorization: User asked for separate subagents/worktrees/PRs investigating truncation, and favored one boundary intervention mirroring resume after400; compare that with the continuous update rule.
